t: Habi smart thermostatic radiator valve head allows for precise temperature control in individual rooms. Compatible with the Habi Matter thermostat and boiler receiver, offering remote control and heating schedule setup via the Habi app. Integrates with standard Matter smart home platforms through a Thread border router. Compact design features an intuitive user interface, and LED display that adjusts for vertical or horizontal installation.
b: Works with - Matter - Amazon Alexa - Apple HomeKit - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
